actions.action: Bind callouts to explicit evidence checks
actions.mechanism: Reevaluate descriptive claims against versioned evidence, separating invalid claims, changed scope, and immaterial revisions.
actions.implementation: Store metric/filter IDs, resolved dates, cited values, and analyst-selected predicates and tolerances. Compare after refresh; flag unsupported free-text claims for review.
actions.check: A ranking reversal invalidates its callout; changed dates flag scope; a within-tolerance revision logs change without invalidation.
actions.risk: Poorly chosen tolerances can conceal meaningful changes; trends cannot establish causation.

actions.action: Keep missing evidence distinct from zero
actions.mechanism: Typed evidence states prevent absent series and incomplete observations from silently becoming numeric zero.
actions.implementation: Represent absent series, null observations, and observed zeros separately. Define completeness requirements per annotation; mark claims indeterminate when required observations are unavailable.
actions.check: Remove a series, null one required observation, then supply zero: verify distinct states and no missing-to-zero coercion.
actions.risk: Existing aggregations may hide missingness before annotation checks run.

actions.action: Queue changed callouts for bounded review
actions.mechanism: A persistent review queue absorbs refresh bursts without treating delayed review as completed validation.
actions.implementation: Coalesce pending items per annotation while preserving change history. Prioritize invalid claims; bind acknowledgments to evidence fingerprints. On capacity overflow, mark affected charts unreviewed.
actions.check: Run successive refreshes during review: newer evidence invalidates stale acknowledgment, and overflow leaves a visible export blocker.
actions.risk: Persistent refresh volume can exceed review capacity; never silently discard pending changes.

actions.mechanism: An export preflight couples annotation review with the exact chart data version being rendered.
actions.implementation: Freeze chart data and annotations together. Present unresolved evidence changes; require correction, omission, or visible qualification. Embed dataset version, evidence bindings, resolved dates, and review status.
actions.check: Refresh during export: output must use one frozen version. Verify unresolved changes appear before export and metadata identifies rendered data.
actions.risk: Formats that strip metadata need a paired manifest and visible version identifier.
